book.title: THE METAMORPHOSIS
book.subtitle: A CEFR A1 Educational Adaptation of Franz Kafka
book.author: Franz Kafka
book.adaptation_note_pt: Adaptação educacional com inglês simplificado. O enredo, a atmosfera sombria, os conflitos, a filosofia e o final da obra são preservados.

week.title: A Strange Morning

opening_illustration.alt_text: Gregor is in his bedroom on a gray morning. His body has changed into a large insect-like form. The bed, window, desk and clock are visible around him.

before_you_read: What do you usually think about first when you wake up?
Is being late for work or school stressful for you?
Can a person work too much? Why?
story: His bedroom is quiet, and the light outside the window is gray.
It is not the body he knows.
He looks down at himself and does not understand what he sees.
For a moment, he is silent.
Then he looks around the room.
A picture is on the wall.
Everything in the room is normal.
Gregor works as a traveling salesman.
He travels a lot for his job.
He takes trains early in the morning and returns home tired.
He does not like his job.
But Gregor cannot simply leave his job.
Gregor helps his mother, his father and his younger sister, Grete.
“Maybe I can take the next train.”
He tries to get out of bed.
His new body does not move like his old body.
Then he hears his mother's voice outside the bedroom.
“Gregor? It is almost seven. Are you going to work?”
That is not his normal voice.
Outside the room, there is silence.
His father calls from another door.
He needs to leave the bedroom.
He needs to go to work.
But how can he explain something that he does not understand?
He looks at the clock again.
Then Gregor hears a new sound.
Someone is at the apartment door.
He hears his father walking through the apartment.
Then he hears another man's voice.
The visitor is from his office.
So work has come to Gregor.

visual_reflection.title: The Closed Door
visual_reflection.alt_text: Gregor is inside his dark bedroom near the bed. A wooden doorway separates him from Mrs. Samsa, Mr. Samsa and Grete, who stand in the brighter hallway looking worried.
questions: Why is the closed door important in this scene?

items: Gregor is ______ because he is late.
He usually takes a ______ to work.

reading_comprehension.question: Where is Gregor when he wakes up?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: He is in his bedroom / in his bed.

reading_comprehension.question: What is different in the room?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Gregor's body is different. The room is normal.

reading_comprehension.question: Why is Gregor worried about the clock?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Because he is late for work and missed his train.

reading_comprehension.question: What is strange about Gregor's voice?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: It does not sound normal / it sounds different.

reading_comprehension.question: Who arrives at the Samsa apartment?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: The chief clerk from Gregor's office.

reading_comprehension.question: Gregor has a very serious problem. Why does he still think so much about work?
reading_comprehension.suggested_answer: Open answer. Expected idea: responsibility, family money, fear of his job or manager.

true_false.statement: Gregor wakes up in a hotel.
Gregor is worried because he is late for work.
Gregor loves traveling for his job.
A person from Gregor's office comes to the apartment.

reflection.title: Think About the Story
reflection.prompt: Why does Gregor think about work before he thinks deeply about his transformation?
reflection.sentence_starter: I think Gregor thinks about work because...

grammar_focus.title: Verb To Be + Adjectives
grammar_focus.explanation: We use am, is and are to describe people, things and situations.

items: The bedroom is ______ in the morning.
He often feels ______ because of his job.

speaking_mission.title: How Does Gregor Feel?
sentence_starters: I think Gregor is afraid because...
speaking_mission.challenge: What is Gregor's biggest problem at this moment?
speaking_mission.challenge_starter: I think his biggest problem is...

story_image_activity.instruction: Look again at the opening illustration and find the objects.
story_image_activity.question: Which object is most important in Chapter 1? Why?

kafkas_question.prompt: Was Gregor completely free before the transformation?

prediction.context: Someone from Gregor's office is now inside the apartment. Gregor is still behind the closed bedroom door.
prediction.question: What do you think happens next?

learning_outcomes: Understand why Gregor is worried about work.
Begin thinking about work, responsibility and freedom in the story.
